    <h2 style="margin-top: 0; color: var(--primary-dark);">Hi, I'm Jace.</h2>
    <p>
      I am a marine data scientist specializing in the intersection of oceanography, geospatial data analysis, and predictive machine learning. My work focuses on modeling complex ocean dynamics—from forecasting Harmful Algal Blooms (HABs) using deep learning to predicting marine species distributions using telemetry and remote sensing.
    </p>
    <p>
      With a background spanning physical ocean conditions, marine ecology, and computational modeling, I build data workflows that transform raw spatial and temporal datasets into actionable insights for coastal management and environmental research.
    </p>

    <h3 style="color: var(--primary-dark); margin-top: 1.5rem;">Core Technical Toolkit</h3>

      <li><strong>Geospatial &amp; Earth Observation:</strong> Google Earth Engine (GEE), QGIS, ArcGIS, GDAL, NetCDF / Raster Processing</li>
      <li><strong>Oceanographic Data:</strong> HYCOM, NOAA/NCEP Reanalysis, MODIS, Copernicus Marine, TOPP Telemetry</li>
